mappings.assertion: TestS1SizeGuard (run by make lint) fails on a stale ratchet entry for a function no longer above 100 lines. supersedeTaskWithOptionalAuthority is now the entry (supersedePass, checkRequest before any invocation, then supersede under the ownership lock): admit before the lock (pipeline bundle, state read, authority, observed task, request, pre-lock receipt replay projected by result, eligibility through checkEligible and supersedable), the pre-lock salvage snapshot for no-replacement supersession, commit inside the one lifecycleMutation (lookup and observed, receipt replay, status recheck, supersedeTaskInState, conditional ValidateCandidate, CompleteLifecycleRequest), result projection, and cleanup (worktree directory, own branch only without replacements, predecessor branches). cancelTaskWithOptionalAuthority is likewise the entry of cancelPass: admit, commit (lookup, receipt replay, status recheck, terminal refusal, completion), retire (lifecycle advance, ABANDONED transition, ownership release, attempt and runtime-input retirement, audit entry, rewriteActiveDependents), result and cleanup (worktree directory, unconditional own-branch deletion, predecessor branches). Every function is within the S1 limits and both keys are removed from area_a4_test.go.

The existing supersede-task, cancel-task, blocked-recovery, salvage and predecessor-cleanup tests in supersede_task_test.go, cancel_task_test.go, predecessor_cleanup_test.go and the in-transaction core comparison run unchanged in what they assert: replacement rewrite, own-downstream pruning, invalid-candidate rollback, no-replacement salvage and branch deletion with masked recoverability command, worktree cleanup, BLOCKED recovery, every source status, consumer dependency removal on cancel, stale operations after cancel, terminal refusal, and branch deletion without a worktree. TestSupersedeTask_LifecycleDecisionsOfMovedSteps and TestCancelTask_LifecycleDecisionsOfMovedSteps add the moved decisions no test reached, driving the extracted admit and commit steps directly for the locked status recheck.

TestOracleRetirePaths adds the thirteen cases (supersede-task: replay, archived_replay, no_replacements, no_replacements_refused, source_worktree, blocked_recovery, blocked_unchanged_refused, predecessor_cleanup; cancel-task: replay, archived_replay, worktree, predecessor_cleanup, dependents_rewritten) with json, human and state goldens, refs listings for the seven cases whose branch and worktree effects the state cannot show, and the retire-archival, retire-worktree, retire-blocked and retire-predecessor fixtures. They were committed in 3e51aa86d, an oracle-only commit that precedes the production edit, generated by regen -mode write-new from the unchanged production tree; regen -mode check -pkg ./internal/oracle/a4 reproduces them and every older A4 golden, which are untouched. Negative proofs, each restored: disabling the supersede own-branch deletion failed supersede-task/no_replacements; disabling the cancel own-branch deletion and the cancel worktree removal failed cancel-task/worktree; disabling the predecessor cleanup failed supersede-task/predecessor_cleanup and cancel-task/predecessor_cleanup; disabling the supersede worktree removal failed supersede-task/no_replacements and source_worktree. No existing oracle file, fixture or golden is edited.

The operation names are the file-local constants supersedeTaskOperation and cancelTaskOperation with their former spelling, and both operations pass LifecycleSafeActionCorrectInput, Stop and Requery and LifecycleEffectsNone instead of literals. TestSupersedeTask_LifecycleDecisionsOfMovedSteps and TestCancelTask_LifecycleDecisionsOfMovedSteps assert outcome, safe action and effects of the request check, the eligibility and terminal refusals and the locked status recheck by literal spelling, independent of the constants.

The live TestOracleSupersedeTask, TestOracleCancelTask and TestOracleReplaceTask run against their unchanged goldens under make test, with the thirteen new goldens; supersedeTaskInState, checkBlockedRecovery, collectSupersedeSalvageSnapshot, predecessor_cleanup.go, dependency_rewrite.go, plan_replacement.go, the exported types and signatures, the CLI and commands are untouched.

TestEveryRatchetKeyIsInTheSnapshotOnceAndPlacedInOneArea and TestS1SizeGuard (make lint) pass with the supersedeTaskLifecycle and cancelTaskLifecycle keys removed from area_a4_test.go; supersede_task.go, cancel_task.go, task_retirement_cleanup.go and every function in them are within the S1 limits.
